tip.en: After a half-kilometre of gentle rolling at 6-7%, the grade jumps to 12%+ here and won't relent for nearly 300 metres. Your heart rate was still climbing through 149—shorten your stride now rather than fighting it, or you'll blow up before the first ridgeline.
tip.zh: 平缓段之后坡度骤升至12%以上，且将持续近300米。此时心率仍在攀升至149——立即缩短步幅，否则在第一道山脊前体力就会透支。

title.en: HR Ceiling Reached on the Spine

tip.en: Heart rate hit 166—your run max—here at 1.7 km while grinding an 8-9% slope at 8+ min/km. Your recent 8-run average HR is only 149, and your flat 10K prep run two days ago averaged 148; this is a full 17 beats higher. This is the physiological peak of the race, not a later climb.
tip.zh: 心率在1.7公里处攀至166次——本次最高值——同时在8-9%坡度上以8分+/公里艰难前行。最近8次跑步平均心率仅149，此刻高出17次。这才是全程真正的生理顶峰。

title.en: Scarecrow Descent — Best Legs of the Run
title.zh: 最快下坡段——全程腿部状态最佳

tip.en: From 2.5 km you ripped a 3:48 split down a -14% chute—the fastest pace of the entire run. Heart rate held at 160 without spiking, suggesting your legs were loading well. Notice how you carried this momentum onto the flat at km 2.6 and held sub-5:00 pace for 300 m; that's the technique to replicate on later descents.
tip.zh: 2.5公里处以3:48的配速冲下-14%的陡坡——全程最快。心率稳在160未飙升，说明腿部承载良好。注意你将这股势能带入2.6公里平段后，连续300米保持了5分内配速，这是后续下坡值得复现的技术。

title.en: Cardiac Creep on the Second Climb
title.zh: 第二段上坡心率悄然漂移

tip.en: HR climbed back to 165 on a modest 2.5% grade at km 2.8—only 90 seconds after coming off the fast descent. That rapid rebound means cardiac drift is setting in; this run is significantly more demanding than your recent 42 m average gain training, and fatigue is starting to compound the aerobic cost.
tip.zh: 仅在快速下坡90秒后，心率就在2.8公里2.5%缓坡上重新爬至165。如此迅速的反弹说明心率漂移已经出现；本次213米爬升远超近期训练均值42米，累积疲劳正在放大有氧消耗。

tip.en: A clean -15% switchback drops you 25 metres in under 200 m at km 3.7, and HR falls to 153. This is the longest genuine recovery stretch in the first half—use it to reset breathing before the long coastal grind that starts at km 3.8.
tip.zh: 3.7公里处-15%的之字形下坡在不足200米内降落25米，心率回落至153。这是前半程最长的真正恢复段——充分利用它调整呼吸，为3.8公里起步的漫长沿岸爬升做好准备。

tip.en: From km 3.8 to 4.4 you've been climbing continuously at 3-6% for over six minutes. HR has crept from 152 to 163, and pace is now 9:55 on a 5.8% pitch. This creeping HR-to-pace deterioration is the signature of cumulative climb fatigue—a pattern absent from your flat prep run six days ago.
tip.zh: 从3.8到4.4公里，你在3-6%坡段持续爬升超过六分钟。心率从152爬升至163，配速在5.8%坡度上已退至9:55。这种心率与配速同步恶化的模式，是累积爬升疲劳的典型标志——六天前的平路准备跑中完全未出现。

title.en: Second Summit Sector — Pace Collapses to 18-min/km
title.zh: 第二山顶段——配速崩至18分/公里

tip.en: Around km 5.5, pace drops to 18:07 on a 7.6% grade and HR falls to 151—a classic sign of a forced micro-walk. This is 500 m before the true crux wall at 5.7-5.8 km, so arrive here with more in reserve: banking earlier effort on the coastal climb (km 4-5) is the fix.
tip.zh: 约5.5公里处，配速在7.6%坡度上跌至18:07，心率降至151——典型的被迫微行走信号。这里距5.7-5.8公里的真正关键陡壁还有500米，需要留有余力抵达：解决方法是在4-5公里沿岸爬升段更早收敛强度。

title.en: The 15% Wall — Deepest Effort of the Race

tip.en: From km 5.8 to 5.85, grade sustains 15%+ for nearly 50 metres; paces swing from 13 to 19 min/km while HR holds 159-161. This is the technical crux—not the steepest point in raw grade, but the longest sustained 15%+ wall after already 20 minutes of climbing. Pole technique or arm-drive would transfer here.
tip.zh: 5.8至5.85公里段坡度持续超过15%达近50米，配速在13至19分/公里间波动，心率维持159-161。这是技术性关键难点——坡度未必是全程最大，但在已爬升20分钟后，这是最长的持续15%+陡壁。手臂驱动或杆式技术在此处最有价值。

title.en: Ridgeline Shoulder — HR Drops 20 Beats in 5 Minutes
title.zh: 山脊肩部——5分钟心率骤降20次

tip.en: After cresting the wall, HR falls from 161 to 146 across km 5.8-6.3 on flat to mild terrain. This is the most aggressive natural recovery in the entire run—your body is finally getting oxygen back. Resist the urge to push hard here; let the HR drop to 140 before the next climb at 6.8 km.
tip.zh: 越过陡壁后，在5.8-6.3公里平缓路段心率从161降至146，这是全程最强烈的自然恢复段。此时身体终于在偿还氧债——克制在此猛踩的冲动，让心率降至140后再应对6.8公里的下一个上坡。

title.en: Third Kick Wall — Body Was Fooled by the Flat
title.zh: 第三陡坡来袭——平段之后猝不及防

tip.en: After 400 m of gentle climbing at 2-3%, grade suddenly spikes to 12% at km 6.9 and HR bounces from 150 back to 153 almost immediately. Each successive climb is extracting more cost per metre than the last—evidence of progressive fatigue that wasn't present in your flat 10K prep run.
tip.zh: 经过400米2-3%的缓坡后，6.9公里处坡度骤升至12%，心率几乎立刻从150反弹至153。每一段上坡的单位消耗都在递增——这正是渐进性疲劳的证据，在你的平路准备跑中完全不存在。

title.en: Summit Descent Begins — 15% Drop, Legs Finally Work With You
title.zh: 顶部下坡启动——15%坡度，腿部终获顺势

tip.en: At km 8.0, altitude starts dropping fast from 129 m at -15%, HR falling from 139 to 129. This is structurally similar to the km 2.5 descent where you ran 3:48—but legs have 6+ km more load now. Lean forward and let gravity help, but keep cadence up to avoid quad-lock on the final 2 km flat.
tip.zh: 8.0公里处，海拔从129米开始以-15%快速下降，心率从139降至129。结构上类似2.5公里处跑出3:48的下坡——但此时双腿已多背负了6公里的负荷。前倾借助重力，同时保持步频，以免在最后2公里平路上股四头肌锁死。

title.en: Late-Race Steepest Drop — HR Spikes Back to 155
title.zh: 赛末最陡下坡——心率反弹至155

tip.en: A brutal -17% chute at km 8.7 pushes HR back up to 155-162 from a low of 143—braking eccentric load is now costing as much aerobically as climbing. This is the steepest descent in the run; landing heel-first here would torch your quads for the final kilometre. Shorten stride, mid-foot strike.
tip.zh: 8.7公里处-17%的陡坡将心率从143低点反弹至155-162——制动离心负荷的有氧消耗此刻与上坡不相上下。这是全程最陡下坡；此处脚跟落地会在最后一公里彻底燃烧股四头肌——缩短步幅，改用中足着地。

title.en: Final Kilometre Surge — HR Climbing Without Terrain
title.zh: 最后一公里冲刺——心率无坡自升

tip.en: From km 9.9 on nearly flat ground (-1 to -2%), HR climbs from 160 to 163-165 and pace drops under 5:00—this is a voluntary push on tired legs. Compared to your flat prep run average of 6:24/km, you're finishing 90 seconds per km faster on a day with 213 m of gain. That's a strong close.
tip.zh: 从9.9公里几乎平坦路段（-1至-2%）起，心率从160主动攀升至163-165，配速压至5分内——这是疲惫双腿上的主动冲刺。相比平路准备跑的平均6:24/公里，你在213米爬升日的收尾快了近90秒/公里——完美收官。
